item.title: NBX registrert som MoneyGram-agent (børsmelding, engelsk)
item.title_en: NBX registered as a MoneyGram agent (stock exchange release)
item.summary: Norwegian Block Exchange (NBX), listed on Euronext Growth Oslo, has been registered as an agent for MoneyGram International.
